text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Tickezo, are you okay?! I know<n>it's hard, but
if you scratch 'em, they<n>might start swell'n up.
Stay strong for<n>me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Right, I'm strong! Sorry for worrying<n>you, Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was just so happy that everyone<n>celebrated my
birthday with me today,<n>y'know?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Every time I think about that, the tears<n>start
flowing... I-I'b juss sooo<n>habbyyy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't... I can't bring m'self to tell<n>her! I couldn't
possibly make Tickezo<n>suffer even more!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yuki, didja say my name?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-not at all! I was just think'n I better<n>give you the
waist warmer I got you<n>t'morrow...
